text:
We often celebrate the magic of open source but overlook the hidden cost of maintenance. Writing the initial code is a feat, but the constant work of patching security vulnerabilities and managing shifting dependencies is a drain on developer energy.

Without dedicated funding for this "boring" upkeep, the digital infrastructure we all rely on slowly decays. We must start rewarding the people
